<!-- Code generated by tools/plugin-prompts from plugins/prompt-source; DO NOT EDIT. -->

Archived: fetches as `archived`, every version kept, no unarchive tool (the operator restores). `mark_archive` archives and drops, in each ancestor hub, the bullets that only linked what was archived. Read-only until step 4.

`$ARGUMENTS`: one path; trailing `/` means directory. Empty: ask. Never `/index.md` or the store root; a project hub only inside its own directory target.

## Soul and project

Slug: the project the user names or confirms, matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$`; never the working directory, a sandbox path. None named: ask once, unless the command accepts a blank slug for the whole soul. No shell helper here: never run shell, use `mark_*` tools only. Store: the local soul, served by the `demarkus-memory` MCP server; a tool not connected or missing (older server): say so, name the server, stop.

A slug never proves identity. Before the first read or write, `mark_fetch /<slug>/index.md` with `force: true`; keep the result (body, version, metadata map) as the hub state. `ok` or `archived`: the subtree is this checkout's only when established this session (a checkout path recorded in the hub matches, or the user confirmed); otherwise the user confirms or picks a unique slug matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$`. `not-found`: `mark_list /<slug>/` with `include_archived: true`; any entry means the subtree exists without a hub, same confirmation; `not-found` or an empty complete page: new project. Any other failure: identity unknown, surface it, ask before writing.

## Steps

1. **Confirm the project** from the identity check above: identity unknown: stop. Target outside `/<slug>/`: the user confirms it, else stop. Target inside: new project: nothing to archive, say so, stop.

2. **Collect.** Document: `mark_fetch`; `ok` continues; `archived` or `not-found`: say so, stop; other failure: surface, stop. Directory: `mark_list` to count the live documents (`next-cursor` as `cursor` until `complete: true`, recurse into subdirectories); `not-found` or none: say so, stop; a listing failure: surface, stop.

3. **Gate.** Approval on the exact target: the document, or the directory with its document count. Declined: stop, nothing written.

4. **Archive.** One `mark_archive` call: `url` the path (a broker store: `mark://<world>/<path>`); a directory adds `recursive: true`. The tool archives every document in listing order (bounded at 500), then drops the hub bullets whose links all pointed at what was archived; a bullet with a link elsewhere stays. Tool error: surface verbatim, stop.

5. **Report.** The tool's lines verbatim: paths with versions, failures, `hubs:` bullets dropped, every `note:` (a hub left as it was). `status: partial`: name what did not archive; a bullet linking the directory stays until everything under it is archived.
